summary: authorize-target-update now keeps its prepared target update receipt after a Fence push the remote rejected unless the refetched Fence never took the authorizing candidate. A push that landed while its response was lost, and a Fence another coordinator moved on from that candidate, used to lose the receipt, which stranded the handoff: apply, reauthorize and finish refused because the receipt was missing, abort refused past the intent, and a new authorization refused because the intent already existed.
